title: Aureon: A failed CRM rescued | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 audited and rebuilt Aureon's self-implemented Dynamics CRM in Des Moines so staff could rely on Dynamics 365 for real-time information.
answer: Aureon is a business support services firm headquartered in Des Moines, IA. Years earlier it implemented Dynamics CRM without professional guidance, which led to underuse and reliability issues. We ran a systems audit and process review with Aureon and built a CRM enhancement plan. For the first time, staff can rely on Dynamics 365.

chapters: What was wrong with Aureon's CRM?
Aureon is a business support services firm headquartered in Des Moines, IA. It was founded in 1986 as Iowa Network Services to connect independent telephone companies, and rebranded in 2016.
Several years earlier, Aureon implemented Dynamics CRM without professional guidance. The system struggled to meet its requirements, which led to underuse and reliability issues.
We started with a thorough systems audit and a process review, done together with Aureon.
From that work we built a CRM enhancement plan aimed at Aureon's specific challenges.
For the first time in its history, Aureon and its staff can rely on Dynamics 365 for real-time, relevant information, and use it to manage client relationships.
author: Kristin Caniglia
